description: This file contains implementation of big number (BIGNUM) arithmetic functions, including memory management, comparison, conversion, and bit operations, used in cryptographic computations.

methods.name: BN_num_bits_word
methods.description: Calculates the number of bits needed to represent a BN_ULONG value.

methods.name: BN_num_bits
methods.description: Returns the number of bits needed to represent a BIGNUM.

methods.name: BN_clear_free
methods.description: Clears and frees a BIGNUM, zeroing out its data.

methods.name: BN_free
methods.description: Frees a BIGNUM without necessarily zeroing out data.

methods.name: BN_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new BIGNUM.

methods.name: bn_expand2
methods.description: Expands a BIGNUM's storage to accommodate a specified number of words.

methods.name: BN_set_word
methods.description: Sets a BIGNUM to a specific word value.

methods.name: BN_bin2bn
methods.description: Converts a binary array to a BIGNUM.

methods.name: BN_bn2bin
methods.description: Converts a BIGNUM to a binary array.

methods.name: BN_is_bit_set
methods.description: Checks if a specific bit is set in a BIGNUM.
